gaps.sentence: I couldn't use the meeting room because it ___ (clean) all morning.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was being + cleaned over a period in the past.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't pay because her wallet ___ (steal) at the market.
gaps.hint: earlier past action causing a past problem
gaps.explanation: The theft happened before the failed payment: past perfect passive, had been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: Passengers ___ (ask) to fasten their seatbelts before take-off.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: are + asked. The agent (crew) is obvious and omitted.

gaps.sentence: The invitation ___ (send) to the wrong address — nobody on this street received one.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive: must have been + sent. The evidence forces the conclusion.

gaps.sentence: Your contract will ___ for a further twelve months.
gaps.explanation: After 'will', passive = be + past participle: will be renewed.

gaps.sentence: The matter ___ at this very moment, so no comment yet.
gaps.explanation: Look into (investigate) passivises with the particle kept: is being looked into.
Negative present simple passive: are not + past participle (given).

gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.
